name: Midara na Mansion
source:
Masaru had a quarrel with his boss and quit his job. One day, his uncle offers him to become a caretaker of his apartment and he immediately accepts it. However, it is harder than he expects and peculiar residents also annoy him. He wants to quit, but there lives some beautiful housewives. "Well, I hope something good might happen...."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305042948/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1011121]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
胜与上司争吵后辞去工作。某天，叔叔请他担任公寓管理员，他立刻答应下来。然而，这份工作比想象中更加辛苦，性格古怪的住户也让他心烦。他想辞职，但这里住着几位美丽的家庭主妇。“唔，希望能发生点好事……”

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305042948/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1011121]Eroge Shop[/url]]
